SoftPretzel.Name: Soft Pretzel
SoftPretzel.Description: Norm's specialty: a soft pretzel baked to perfection and topped with salt. It's still warm.
AppleButter.Name: Apple Butter
AppleButter.Description: A sweet condiment made by cooking apples for many hours, until they fully break down into a paste and the sugars caramelize.
Scrapple.Name: Scrapple
Scrapple.Description: A kind of pork meat loaf, made from butchering scraps, which is sliced and fried. It's an acquired taste.
ChickenPotPie.Name: Chicken Pot Pie
ChickenPotPie.Description: Chicken, vegetables, and handmade square noodles in a thick broth. 'Pie' is not really the right word for it.
WhoopiePie.Name: Whoopie Pie
WhoopiePie.Description: A handheld cake sandwich made with rich chocolate cake and creamy white icing. Heart-stoppingly sweet. Also, not a pie.
ShooflyPie.Name: Shoo-fly Pie
ShooflyPie.Description: A molasses crumb cake baked in a pie crust. Just barely a pie. This is the wet-bottom version, so try not to make a mess when eating it.
FunnelCake.Name: Funnel Cake
FunnelCake.Description: Fried dough made by pouring batter through a funnel into hot oil. Served with powdered sugar.
Fasnacht.Name: Fasnacht
Fasnacht.Description: A square doughnut fried in lard and traditionally eaten before a period of fasting.
AppleDumpling.Name: Apple Dumpling
AppleDumpling.Description: Spiced apples baked in a pastry shell and served with caramel and vanilla ice cream.
BirchBeer.Name: Birch Beer
BirchBeer.Description: A carbonated soft drink made from birch sap and other flavorings.
